notes: Static audit of current source and catalogue, not player telemetry. Unused means the displayed artwork has no current normal-game appearance route; the named gameplay object or item may still be active.
Planned means approved reference art with no implemented placement/render route. Do not remove planned art automatically.
All 353 item rows have a traced acquisition route; no item is marked unused. This includes furniture and dynamically generated gear, animals and tomes.

World catalogue has 267 rows. Review traced catalogue inclusion, live render dispatch and dynamic selectors; only proven retired or unimplemented rows are flagged. Unflagged world rows are not a guarantee of exhaustive playthrough coverage.
Audit is a source snapshot. Revisit findings if the evidence files change. Development sandboxes and art preview tools are outside normal-game use.
